title: alex-martin-sre-oncall-scratchpad-2026-03-06
content:
On-call day notes (quick scratchpad)
Date: 2026-03-06
Primary contact: Alex Martin (oncall)
Shift: 09:00 - 17:00 PT

09:12 - PAGE: alert svc-high-5xx-rate (pagerduty)
- Symptoms: sudden spike in 5xx responses from hosted API region-us-east-1. Error window ~09:10-09:25.
- Initial triage: checked infra dashboard (grafana) -> increased error rate on route /v1/generate and /v1/chat. CPU on frontend pods normal, backend inference pool saw queue depth spike.
- Actions taken: routed new traffic to warm fallback pool (route fallback-policy) -> error rate started to drop ~09:20.
- Notes: likely autoscaler lag + model warm-up issue after a rolling deploy earlier this morning (A/B deploy task a.m.).

09:35 - Post-incident quick notes:
- Incident ticket: JIRA-7654 created (summary: us-east-1 5xx spike, 09:10-09:25). Assigned to Priya for follow-up.
- Linked runbook: CONFLUENCE-incident-runbook-42 (incomplete steps for model warm-up).
- Immediate mitigation: traffic routed to dedicated fallback model variant v1.3-quantized; rollback of canary aborted because canary already drained.
- Customer impact: transient increased latency for some requests and ~15m window with elevated 5xx rate; no data loss. Notified CS/escalation per policy.

Follow-ups (short):
- Priya: investigate why warm fallback pool did not scale fast enough (look at HPA and autoscaler events). Check if recent autoscaler config change (PR #1023) altered cooldowns.
- Alex: write short remediation in runbook for model warm-up (see TODOs below).
- Noah: run load replay on staging with recent canary config to reproduce queue spike.

Runbook TODOs (action items - keep short):
- TODO-1: Add a pre-warm step to canary deploy flow for staged model warms (owner: Alex) - add checklist and commands.
- TODO-2: Update autoscaler thresholds for inference-pool-us-east to be more aggressive for queue depth > 200 (owner: Priya) - target: reduce scale cold-starts.
- TODO-3: Add alert that specifically tracks model cache miss rate + kv-cache fill latency (owner: Noah).
- TODO-4: Add postmortem template link to JIRA ticket and schedule 30-min blameless review (owner: Alex).

Commands / quick references I ran:
- kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-pool-us-east -o yaml  # check current min/max/metrics
- kubectl -n inference describe deploy inference-pool-us-east  # deployment events
- curl -s "https://grafana.internal/api/ds/query" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{...}'  # grab panels for error rate
- pd incidents list --since 1h --service "hosted-api-us-east"

Notes to self (observations):
- Rolling deploy earlier had a single canary with smaller instance-type (to save cost) -> suspect slow KV cache population on smaller instance causing high tail latencies and 5xx due to OOM / rejection under burst.
- We should add a quick smoke test that sends warm prefixes to new model instances immediately after start to pre-populate KV and model caches. Could be a lightweight curl-based script run by release engineering as part of rollout pipeline.

Customer/CS comms (draft):
- Short message: "We experienced a brief increase in error rates in us-east at ~09:10 UTC due to a model warm-up scaling issue after a deployment. Traffic was routed to a fallback pool and the issue was mitigated by 09:25. We're implementing runbook and autoscaler changes to reduce recurrence. Ticket: JIRA-7654."
- Action: confirm with CS before sending.

Open questions / investigation items:
- Was there any memory pressure on the smaller canary instance leading to OOM/kickouts? (check node-level metrics)
- Did the autoscaler see request queue length but delay scale due to metric aggregator latency? Monitor metrics ingestion delay for the autoscaler.
- Where in the deploy pipeline could we insert a pre-warm step with minimal blast radius?

Hand-off notes (end of shift):
- Leave this doc for next oncall (Priya) - key items assigned as above.
- Add links to postmortem and attach grafana screenshots + pod logs to JIRA-7654.

Misc quick TODOs (personal):
- [ ] Draft runbook section for "model warm-up" with commands and expected time-to-ready.
- [ ] Follow up with release-eng on PR #1023 to confirm intended autoscaler behavior.
- [ ] Add replay script to perf-tests repo and run on staging (owner: Noah to help).

End of shift checklist:
- notify oncall rotation board that follow-ups assigned -> done
- confirm JIRA ticket has assignees and due dates -> pending
- archive this scratchpad under /users for future reference -> this file

---
Quick logs pasted (raw) for later:
[09:15:12] ERROR gateway 5xx rate spike: 256 errors/min, routes: /v1/generate
[09:16:03] INFO routing switched -> fallback-pool
[09:20:45] INFO errors trending down -> 18 errors/min

End notes: keep runbook changes minimal and test in staging before prod.
